title: Base change of a pushforward along an extension of fields with torsion coefficients invertible in the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the pushforward of a torsion complex with orders invertible in the base commutes with an extension of base fields (statement lines 18031-18040). The proof (proof lines 18042-18063) handles separable extensions by the smooth base change lemma for filtered colimits of smooth algebras, and reduces the general case to that one by passing to perfect closures, where topological invariance identifies the etale sites. H2: one base change application plus one reduction, written out.
